entities.summary: James Lindsay Almond Jr. was an American lawyer, jurist, and Democratic party politician. His political offices included as a member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Virginia's 6th congressional district (1946–1948), 26th attorney general of Virginia (1948–1957) and the 58th governor of Virginia (1958–1962).
